comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
I was curious about your report and repeated the quest. Before I share my finding, let me explain a few things:

1. Certain "wild" astronomy discoveries (IE, no map or quest associated with them) exist in particular time periods accessed from the World Clock; if the Clock is not set to their period, these discoveries can only be discovered with Chrono titles or Age Effect EX equipment equipped.

2. Quest discoveries do not require the use of Chrono titles/Era EX equipment. That includes Astronomy quest discoveries.

3. Regardless of titles or quests, all Astronomy discoveries can only be found at certain times of day/night or with certain weather conditions.

Now then, if you use Recognition during the day or night, the game will tell you that "In the current time, it's not possible to observe the astronomical object." That is because as the final quest note states, you need to "observe the evening Sun to find the black spot." You need to use Recognition at sunset to complete this quest.

I hope this helps; I've updated the quest steps slightly so it is clearer about the time frame. Cheers, great online voyaging to you.

comments.author: Fawn
comments.body: Ty for setting me straight Guilder. I tried again with 15C-P1 and I could discover just by the right time of day (dusk). I'll delete my comments above not to confuse anyone.
